name: Can one contractor manage both finish carpentry and trade coordination for a kitchen rehab?

mainEntity.name: Can one contractor manage both finish carpentry and trade coordination for a kitchen rehab?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, an owner-operated general contractor can oversee the entire refresh by managing specialized trades while completing finish carpentry, drywall, and tile in-house. Foreclosed homes often need multiple skills simultaneously: drywall patching where appliances were removed, subfloor repair, custom trim, tile backsplashes, and interior painting. Working with a hands-on general contractor gives you a single point of contact on-site. The contractor handles carpentry and aesthetic finishes directly while scheduling and coordinating trade specialists for plumbing connections and electrical adjustments, keeping communication simple and preventing scheduling bottlenecks on your rehab project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. A hands-on general contractor completes carpentry, drywall, and tile directly while coordinating specialized plumbing and electrical trades under one point of contact.
